meta.description: BRICK RUSH 99 化學技能表 V2.0。已拆分 description 與 category 為單人/多人獨立欄位。
meta.derivedFieldsNote: atomCount 由 elements 內所有數量加總得出；avgAtomicWeight = molecularWeight / atomCount；strength 由下方公式在遊戲載入時即時計算，不寫死在本檔案中。 V2.0：所有技能起始 Lv.1；升級上限依分子量；HP/Shield/Damage 使用百分比。
meta.strengthFormula: strength = clamp(molecularWeight * STRENGTH_BASE_COEFFICIENT - avgAtomicWeight * AVG_ATOMIC_WEIGHT_PENALTY_COEFFICIENT, MIN_STRENGTH, MAX_STRENGTH)
balanceNotes: Ball drop remains the primary death threat; dropPenalty formula is unchanged at 20 + level × 2 percent.
Light damage keeps 0.18 growth and max Lv.15.
Medium damage growth reduced from 0.28 to 0.20 to keep Lv.10 near 98% HP.
Heavy damage growth reduced from 0.55 to 0.50; 60% Lv.1 heavy skills are normalized to 50%, giving Lv.5 = 150%.
Healing and shield scaling are unchanged from the source baseline.
Categories recalibrated based on actual Single/Multi physics actions.
